profTagline: The Book of Changes casts a hexagram the way it was cast with yarrow stalks or three coins — and those two methods carry DIFFERENT odds, not the same ones. With stalks, yang turns to yin three times as often as yin turns to yang; coins are symmetric. The app computes honestly: the hexagram, its trigrams, the moving lines, and the second hexagram it changes into. The interpretation is written by a model on top of that structure and marked as generated — there is no canonical text here.
